scenario: a change or choice involving school & learning
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Change or Choice Involving School and Learning
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: school & learning — a change or choice involving school & learning
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a change or choice involving school & learning; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr James whether he prefers the morning class or the evening class.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi anh James thích lớp buổi sáng hay buổi tối hơn.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: James, do you prefer the morning class or the evening class?
turns.vietnamese: James này, anh thích lớp buổi sáng hay buổi tối hơn?

turns.speaker: Mr James
turns.vietnamese: Cho tôi lớp buổi tối nhé.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Noted, the evening class it is.
turns.vietnamese: Ghi nhận rồi, vậy lớp buổi tối nhé.
